reports.name: Lower Columbia River
reports.text:
No report.
Bonneville Pool: No report.
The Dalles Pool: Weekly checking showed three sub-legal, 15 legal, and 14 over-legal sized white sturgeon released for two boats (six anglers).
John Day Pool: Weekly checking showed four legal, and three over-legal sized white sturgeon released for two boats (five anglers).
WALLEYE

reports.name: Lower Columbia River (below Bonneville Dam)
reports.text:
No report.
Bonneville Pool: Weekly checking showed two walleye kept and one walleye released for one boat (one angler; and no catch for two bank anglers.
The Dalles Pool: Weekly checking showed four walleye kept and one walleye released for five boats (seven anglers).
John Day Pool: Weekly checking showed 19 walleye kept, and six walleye released for 17 boats (30 anglers).
